defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)

defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Gusarov, Yadroitsev, Bertrand & Smurov 2007, Appl. Surf. Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Hofmann et al. 316L single tracks, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16979848 (Mater. Des. 262 (2026) 115459): recorded balled fractions per Eagar-Tsai L/W bin at the fitting commit (evidence only; the former High threshold derived from them was removed in P7b)
Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.35 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionMarginBasis: unsourced screening threshold 0.80; the only published analog is Harkin 2023 Eq. 11 and Conclusions, R_c^2 = 0.7 (R_c 0.83) for analytic Rosenthal geometry, Ti-6Al-4V on one machine; it differs and is not applied. defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)
defectDiagnostics.stressUnavailableReason: unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)

meltPoolGeometry.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
meltPoolGeometry.regimeMaterialNote: threshold not validated for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.regimeKeyholeCutBasis: keyhole mode onset, not a porosity boundary: King 2014 Conclusion (4) and Sec. 5.6 (30 +/- 4 for 316L, 50 um powder layer) with Conclusions (1) and (5) (voids appear in keyhole mode and increase far above the threshold, a qualitative association); Cunningham 2019 p.2 (keyhole threshold and morphology by x-ray imaging); Zhao 2020 (Science 370, 1080: energy density threshold about 3.7 MJ/m2 below which no keyhole pores form, no pore condition below index 15, stable keyholes up to 62); Huang 2022 (doi 10.1038/s41467-022-28694-x: the transition to unstable keyhole melting is alloy dependent, H/hm x Lth about 8 +/- 3 for Ti-6Al-4V and 20 +/- 3 for Al7A77 in that paper's units); cut 20: transferred from the 316L and Ti-6Al-4V bases, not derived for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.axialFieldMaximumUnavailableReason: the Rosenthal axial maximum is the regularised singular-source value T0 + P/(2 pi k r_reg), not a field maximum; removed (P6 containment)

processParameters.effectiveAbsorptivityBasis: flat absorptivity of the material authority for the conduction field (Eagar-Tsai 1983 and Goldak 1984 take Q as absorbed power; Knapp 2022 finds the IN625 conduction-mode effective absorption near Fresnel 0.30, HT 0.29 to 0.32, HTFF 0.27 to 0.29). No kernel represents the measured absorptance rise in transition and keyhole mode (0.6 to 0.9: Deisenroth 2020 Fig. 7, Trapp 2017 Fig. 3a). The former multi-reflection ramp 1-(1-A)^n (uncited) was removed 2026-10-11. authority value, see absorptivityBasis (P7b: the measured conduction-mode authority where one exists; the dH/hs index reads the separate index convention constant, see absorptivityIndexBasis).
processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. In transition and keyhole mode the measured absorptance is 0.6 to 0.9 (Deisenroth 2020 Fig 7, Trapp 2017 Fig 3a, Fabbro 2020 Sec 4.1); the field and the Fabbro leg use this conduction value, a disclosed lower bound there (see FABBRO_BASIS; replacement is P3). Not a powder layer value.
processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

processParameters.effectiveAbsorptivityBasis: flat absorptivity of the material authority for the conduction field (Eagar-Tsai 1983 and Goldak 1984 take Q as absorbed power; Knapp 2022 finds the IN625 conduction-mode effective absorption near Fresnel 0.30, HT 0.29 to 0.32, HTFF 0.27 to 0.29). No kernel represents the measured absorptance rise in transition and keyhole mode (0.6 to 0.9: Deisenroth 2020 Fig. 7, Trapp 2017 Fig. 3a). The former multi-reflection ramp 1-(1-A)^n (uncited) was removed 2026-10-11. authority value, see absorptivityBasis (P7b: the measured conduction-mode authority where one exists; the dH/hs index reads the separate index convention constant, see absorptivityIndexBasis).
processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. In transition and keyhole mode the measured absorptance is 0.6 to 0.9 (Deisenroth 2020 Fig 7, Trapp 2017 Fig 3a, Fabbro 2020 Sec 4.1); the field and the Fabbro leg use this conduction value, a disclosed lower bound there (see FABBRO_BASIS; replacement is P3). Not a powder layer value.
processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Negligible (legacy screening level, dH/hs < 15; porosity unresolved: Zhao 2020 0/35 pore conditions below 15 is not evidence of safety)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.69 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory

meltPoolGeometry.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
meltPoolGeometry.regimeMaterialNote: threshold not validated for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.regimeKeyholeCutBasis: keyhole mode onset, not a porosity boundary: King 2014 Conclusion (4) and Sec. 5.6 (30 +/- 4 for 316L, 50 um powder layer) with Conclusions (1) and (5) (voids appear in keyhole mode and increase far above the threshold, a qualitative association); Cunningham 2019 p.2 (keyhole threshold and morphology by x-ray imaging); Zhao 2020 (Science 370, 1080: energy density threshold about 3.7 MJ/m2 below which no keyhole pores form, no pore condition below index 15, stable keyholes up to 62); Huang 2022 (doi 10.1038/s41467-022-28694-x: the transition to unstable keyhole melting is alloy dependent, H/hm x Lth about 8 +/- 3 for Ti-6Al-4V and 20 +/- 3 for Al7A77 in that paper's units); cut 20: transferred from the 316L and Ti-6Al-4V bases, not derived for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.axialFieldMaximumUnavailableReason: the Rosenthal axial maximum is the regularised singular-source value T0 + P/(2 pi k r_reg), not a field maximum; removed (P6 containment)

processParameters.effectiveAbsorptivityBasis: flat absorptivity of the material authority for the conduction field (Eagar-Tsai 1983 and Goldak 1984 take Q as absorbed power; Knapp 2022 finds the IN625 conduction-mode effective absorption near Fresnel 0.30, HT 0.29 to 0.32, HTFF 0.27 to 0.29). The former multi-reflection ramp 1-(1-A)^n (uncited) was removed 2026-10-11. authority value, see absorptivityBasis (P7b: the measured conduction-mode authority where one exists; the dH/hs index reads the separate index convention constant, see absorptivityIndexBasis).
processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. In transition and keyhole mode the measured absorptance is 0.6 to 0.9 (Deisenroth 2020 Fig 7, Trapp 2017 Fig 3a, Fabbro 2020 Sec 4.1); the field and the Fabbro leg use this conduction value, a disclosed lower bound there (see FABBRO_BASIS; replacement is P3). Not a powder layer value.
processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

The former multi-reflection ramp 1-(1-A)^n (uncited) was removed 2026-10-11. authority value, see absorptivityBasis (P7b: the measured conduction-mode authority where one exists; the dH/hs index reads the separate index convention constant, see absorptivityIndexBasis).
processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. In transition and keyhole mode the measured absorptance is 0.6 to 0.9 (Deisenroth 2020 Fig 7, Trapp 2017 Fig 3a, Fabbro 2020 Sec 4.1); the field and the Fabbro leg use this conduction value, a disclosed lower bound there (see FABBRO_BASIS; replacement is P3). Not a powder layer value.
processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Possible (legacy screening level, 15 <= dH/hs < 30; porosity unresolved by this index: Zhao 2020 Ti-6Al-4V pores observed at dH/hs 16-28 for v <= 445 mm/s)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Gusarov, Yadroitsev, Bertrand & Smurov 2007, Appl. Surf. Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Hofmann et al. 316L single tracks, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16979848 (Mater. Des. 262 (2026) 115459): recorded balled fractions per Eagar-Tsai L/W bin at the fitting commit (evidence only; the former High threshold derived from them was removed in P7b)
Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.52 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionMarginBasis: unsourced screening threshold 0.80; the only published analog is Harkin 2023 Eq. 11 and Conclusions, R_c^2 = 0.7 (R_c 0.83) for analytic Rosenthal geometry, Ti-6Al-4V on one machine; it differs and is not applied. defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)
defectDiagnostics.stressUnavailableReason: unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)

meltPoolGeometry.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
meltPoolGeometry.regimeMaterialNote: threshold not validated for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.regimeKeyholeCutBasis: keyhole mode onset, not a porosity boundary: King 2014 Conclusion (4) and Sec. 5.6 (30 +/- 4 for 316L, 50 um powder layer) with Conclusions (1) and (5) (voids appear in keyhole mode and increase far above the threshold, a qualitative association); Cunningham 2019 p.2 (keyhole threshold and morphology by x-ray imaging); Zhao 2020 (Science 370, 1080: energy density threshold about 3.7 MJ/m2 below which no keyhole pores form, no pore condition below index 15, stable keyholes up to 62); Huang 2022 (doi 10.1038/s41467-022-28694-x: the transition to unstable keyhole melting is alloy dependent, H/hm x Lth about 8 +/- 3 for Ti-6Al-4V and 20 +/- 3 for Al7A77 in that paper's units); cut 20: transferred from the 316L and Ti-6Al-4V bases, not derived for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.axialFieldMaximumUnavailableReason: the Rosenthal axial maximum is the regularised singular-source value T0 + P/(2 pi k r_reg), not a field maximum; removed (P6 containment)

processParameters.effectiveAbsorptivityBasis: flat absorptivity of the material authority for the conduction field (Eagar-Tsai 1983 and Goldak 1984 take Q as absorbed power; Knapp 2022 finds the IN625 conduction-mode effective absorption near Fresnel 0.30, HT 0.29 to 0.32, HTFF 0.27 to 0.29). No kernel represents the measured absorptance rise in transition and keyhole mode (0.6 to 0.9: Deisenroth 2020 Fig. 7, Trapp 2017 Fig. 3a). The former multi-reflection ramp 1-(1-A)^n (uncited) was removed 2026-10-11. authority value, see absorptivityBasis (P7b: the measured conduction-mode authority where one exists; the dH/hs index reads the separate index convention constant, see absorptivityIndexBasis).
processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. In transition and keyhole mode the measured absorptance is 0.6 to 0.9 (Deisenroth 2020 Fig 7, Trapp 2017 Fig 3a, Fabbro 2020 Sec 4.1); the field and the Fabbro leg use this conduction value, a disclosed lower bound there (see FABBRO_BASIS; replacement is P3). Not a powder layer value.
processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Possible (legacy screening level, 15 <= dH/hs < 30; porosity unresolved by this index: Zhao 2020 Ti-6Al-4V pores observed at dH/hs 16-28 for v <= 445 mm/s)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Severe Lack of Fusion (Tang index > 1 — inter-track/layer unmelt)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Negligible (legacy screening level, dH/hs < 15; porosity unresolved: Zhao 2020 0/35 pore conditions below 15 is not evidence of safety)

processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Severe Lack of Fusion (Tang index > 1 — inter-track/layer unmelt)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Negligible (legacy screening level, dH/hs < 15; porosity unresolved: Zhao 2020 0/35 pore conditions below 15 is not evidence of safety)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.19 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)

processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Possible (legacy screening level, 15 <= dH/hs < 30; porosity unresolved by this index: Zhao 2020 Ti-6Al-4V pores observed at dH/hs 16-28 for v <= 445 mm/s)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.05 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)

(12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.49 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)
defectDiagnostics.stressUnavailableReason: unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)

meltPoolGeometry.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
meltPoolGeometry.regimeMaterialNote: threshold not validated for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.regimeKeyholeCutBasis: keyhole mode onset, not a porosity boundary: King 2014 Conclusion (4) and Sec. 5.6 (30 +/- 4 for 316L, 50 um powder layer) with Conclusions (1) and (5) (voids appear in keyhole mode and increase far above the threshold, a qualitative association); Cunningham 2019 p.2 (keyhole threshold and morphology by x-ray imaging); Zhao 2020 (Science 370, 1080: energy density threshold about 3.7 MJ/m2 below which no keyhole pores form, no pore condition below index 15, stable keyholes up to 62); Huang 2022 (doi 10.1038/s41467-022-28694-x: the transition to unstable keyhole melting is alloy dependent, H/hm x Lth about 8 +/- 3 for Ti-6Al-4V and 20 +/- 3 for Al7A77 in that paper's units); cut 20: transferred from the 316L and Ti-6Al-4V bases, not derived for this alloy
meltPoolGeometry.axialFieldMaximumUnavailableReason: no sourced vapour temperature in the library for this alloy (no elemental proxy is used; lead decision, P6 containment): the axial maximum cannot be checked against boiling

processParameters.effectiveAbsorptivityBasis: flat absorptivity of the material authority for the conduction field (Eagar-Tsai 1983 and Goldak 1984 take Q as absorbed power; Knapp 2022 finds the IN625 conduction-mode effective absorption near Fresnel 0.30, HT 0.29 to 0.32, HTFF 0.27 to 0.29). No kernel represents the measured absorptance rise in transition and keyhole mode (0.6 to 0.9: Deisenroth 2020 Fig. 7, Trapp 2017 Fig. 3a). The former multi-reflection ramp 1-(1-A)^n (uncited) was removed 2026-10-11. authority value, see absorptivityBasis (P7b: the measured conduction-mode authority where one exists; the dH/hs index reads the separate index convention constant, see absorptivityIndexBasis).
processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. In transition and keyhole mode the measured absorptance is 0.6 to 0.9 (Deisenroth 2020 Fig 7, Trapp 2017 Fig 3a, Fabbro 2020 Sec 4.1); the field and the Fabbro leg use this conduction value, a disclosed lower bound there (see FABBRO_BASIS; replacement is P3). Not a powder layer value.
processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

processParameters.absorptivityBasis: measured conduction value on an as-built rough AM surface (Sa 22.3 um) in N2 at 1075 nm, Leis 2020 area II minimum; band 0.28 to 0.40; not a polished or ground plate; not a powder layer value. processParameters.absorptivitySource: Leis, Weber, Graf 2020, Procedia CIRP 94, 173 to 176 (leis2020.pdf)
processParameters.absorptivityIndexBasis: convention constant of the dH/hs regime index (the cuts 15, 20, 13.6 and the King conversion 22.2 were derived with it); not a measurement; the base alloy's absorptivity_index_IR is used; the index uses the convention constant 0.18 while the conduction field absorbs the measured 0.30 (67 percent more absorbed power), so the regime label may understate the onset; the cuts were derived at the convention and their re-derivation at the measured absorptivity is a separate lane
processParameters.propertyConventionBasis: conduction k and cp are the Kirchhoff integral mean of the sourced solid k(T) and cp(T) over the isotherm range from the preheat to the liquidus (Carslaw and Jaeger 1959 sec 1.7); exact only for constant diffusivity (Ti-6Al-4V alpha varies about 3.3 times over the range, AlSi10Mg as built about 1.3 times); the liquid k, cp and density do not enter; K 156.848 W/mK, cp 1033.28 J/kgK, alpha 5.63e-05 m2/s; state as built, build direction, held above 800.15 K for k and 773.15 K for cp; kernel density 2696 kg/m3; evaluated at the request preheat 80 C (isotherm range 353.15 to 868.15 K); the dH/hs index and the Fabbro leg keep the solid k_s, cp_s and the room temperature density
processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Possible (legacy screening level, 15 <= dH/hs < 30; porosity unresolved by this index: Zhao 2020 Ti-6Al-4V pores observed at dH/hs 16-28 for v <= 445 mm/s)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.20 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionMarginBasis: unsourced screening threshold 0.80; the only published analog is Harkin 2023 Eq. 11 and Conclusions, R_c^2 = 0.7 (R_c 0.83) for analytic Rosenthal geometry, Ti-6Al-4V on one machine; it differs and is not applied. defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)

processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Possible (legacy screening level, 15 <= dH/hs < 30; porosity unresolved by this index: Zhao 2020 Ti-6Al-4V pores observed at dH/hs 16-28 for v <= 445 mm/s)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696

processParameters.solidConductivityBasis: room temperature value used by the regime index, the keyhole leg and the transient table; the conduction field uses the kernel mean
processParameters.densityBasis: 2680, room temperature convention constant, unsourced; the conduction kernel uses 2696
processParameters.latentHeatPowerFactorBasis: 1.0 for every kernel; latent heat of fusion is excluded from the conduction field (Rubenchik 2018 Sec. 3.1, Gan 2021 SI Method 3), from the index hs and from the Fabbro leg; the former 1/(1+0.55 St) factor (uncited) was removed.

processWindowMap.regimeBasis: dH/hs < 15 conduction, 15-20 transition, >= 20 keyhole mode (melt-pool D/W > 0.5 screening onset); Inconel 625 uses its own cut: < 13.6 conduction, >= 13.6 keyhole mode, no transition band (see the IN625 alloy note). 20 is a provisional screening choice, not a derived exact threshold: it lies in the overlap of King et al. 2014 30+/-4 (316L) converted to the repo convention (19.3-25.2; conditional on the app absorptivity, 20 C preheat and property set; King's printed density unit kg/m3 corrected to 7980 kg/m3) and the Cunningham et al. 2019 Fig. 3A melt-pool transition line (Ti-6Al-4V; app index 17.3-20.0 along speed, a range, not a confidence interval). Both sources and the held-out checks are for Ti-6Al-4V and 316L; transferred, not derived, for IN718/AlSi10Mg and the other alloys. Cunningham and Gan data are not independent validation. Keyhole mode is not keyhole porosity; a low index is not an assurance.
processWindowMap.gridKernelNote: every grid cell is the served Rosenthal field extent (_axial_peak_x, _liquidus_extent) at the authority field power A P with the served k, cp, rho and alpha convention and depth = max(liquidus depth, Fabbro leg), whatever kernel the operating point requested; the former closed-form width sqrt(8/(pi e) A P / (rho cp dT v) + d_beam^2) had no source (G1 audit B17) and the 0.5 w depth bound is dropped. Cells whose extent is not a computed isotherm serve width and depth null with their extentStatus and no Lack of Fusion Zone class.
processWindowMap.ballingNote: Balling is screened at the operating point only (defectDiagnostics.ballingScreen, Eagar-Tsai L/W); the grid has no melt-pool length and marks no balling zone.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionRisk: Full Fusion Bonding (Tang (h/W)^2+(t/D)^2 ≤ 1.0)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityRisk: Possible (legacy screening level, 15 <= dH/hs < 30; porosity unresolved by this index: Zhao 2020 Ti-6Al-4V pores observed at dH/hs 16-28 for v <= 445 mm/s)
defectDiagnostics.keyholePorosityBasis: Porosity unresolved; legacy screening level on the normalised enthalpy, independent of the regime threshold. < 15: Zhao 2020 (doi 10.1126/science.abd1587) found no pore condition below 15 (0/35) and its boundary minimum is 15.0; 0/35 observations is not evidence of safety. >= 30 is an unsourced screening threshold, a legacy porosity level kept as an advisory for continuity, not a porosity boundary (Zhao 2020 stable keyholes up to dH/hs 62 at high speed); since P7a it drives no verdict. Keyhole mode (>= 20) does not imply porosity.

ballingScreen.highBandBasis: no High band since P7b (2026-10-14): the former in-sample 316L edge 5.5 was fitted on the Eagar-Tsai geometry of the fitting commit and that geometry changed (absorptivity authority, melting-point and kernel-ledger properties); Moderate (3.85, Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 proxy) and Stable are the only bands, advisory
ballingScreen.basis: Eagar-Tsai liquidus L/W: Moderate > pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 (Yadroitsev et al. 2010 Eq. 13 cylinder bound, mechanism Gusarov et al. 2007; a wavelength/cylinder-diameter bound applied to the model pool L/W) -> advisory only; no High band since P7b (the former in-sample 316L edge was fitted on a geometry that P7b changed)
sources: Yadroitsev, Gusarov, Yadroitsava & Smurov 2010, J. Mater. Process. Technol. 210:1624 (doi 10.1016/j.jmatprotec.2010.05.010), sec. 3.3 Eq. (12)-(13): segmental-cylinder capillary stability, full-cylinder limit pi*D/L > sqrt(2/3), i.e. L/D < pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85 with D the cylinder diameter (Moderate, advisory)

Gusarov, Yadroitsev, Bertrand & Smurov 2007, Appl. Surf. Sci. 254:975 (doi 10.1016/j.apsusc.2007.08.074), sec. 3-4: balling above ~20 cm/s (316L, 50 um layer) explained by the Plateau-Rayleigh break-up of the remelted cylinder when its length exceeds its circumference; substrate contact stabilises (mechanism, no threshold on pool L/W)

Hofmann et al. 316L single tracks, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16979848 (Mater. Des. 262 (2026) 115459): recorded balled fractions per Eagar-Tsai L/W bin at the fitting commit (evidence only; the former High threshold derived from them was removed in P7b)
Eagar & Tsai 1983, Welding J. 62:346s: beam-size-aware kernel that supplies L and W

evidence.limits: calibrated in-sample on one 316L dataset (Aconity Midi, 50-140 um spots); not validated for IN718, Ti-6Al-4V or other alloys (no labelled balling set in the repo); the NIST AMB2022-03 IN718 285 W / 960 mm/s track is continuous at Eagar-Tsai L/W ~5.1 (Moderate); low-energy powder-layer balling is not captured by L/W; experimentalValidation=false

ballingScreen.reason: Eagar-Tsai L/W 1.40 <= pi*sqrt(3/2) = 3.85; 34/361 Hofmann 316L tracks in this band balled.

defectDiagnostics.lackOfFusionMarginBasis: unsourced screening threshold 0.80; the only published analog is Harkin 2023 Eq. 11 and Conclusions, R_c^2 = 0.7 (R_c 0.83) for analytic Rosenthal geometry, Ti-6Al-4V on one machine; it differs and is not applied. One lack-of-fusion rule for both screens: the Tang unit criterion
defectDiagnostics.recoaterCrashRisk: unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)
defectDiagnostics.distortionIndexBasis: unavailable since P7a (2026-10-11): the former alloy/layer/preheat-only index 0.72 E alpha dT / (1 - nu) x (layer / 40 um) / 420 MPa used unsourced constants and is not served; unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)
defectDiagnostics.stressUnavailableReason: unavailable: no sourced stress model (Mercelis and Kruth 2006 supports a yield cap only, and the yield values are unsourced)
